text: The User Interface Designer will design a menu that encompasses all listed functions.
User feedback highlights dissatisfaction with remote control look-and-feel and usability, and devices are frequently misplaced.
There is uncertainty about whether the project file saves automatically and where it is stored.
The decisions establish two groups of functions—simple for the broad public and advanced options for younger users—and remove teletext and the newsflash features.
The product will keep core remote functions with improved usability and physical design, and will include corporate identity with a consistent logo and colors.
